svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Floors view: application floor over infrastructure floor (hold V, INC-2041)
svg.desc: Perspective 3D view with two stacked floors. The application topology floats as a translucent upper floor: services are glowing discs joined by dependency edges inside faint team territories. The infrastructure city of prod-eu-1 sits below as node buildings grouped by pool. The causal path checkout → payments → psp-api is lit on the application floor (checkout and payments desaturated victims with dashed rings, psp-api Failing with the ⊕ beacon and the ⚙ 12:19 timeout change on payments), then a magenta runs-on thread crosses down from psp-api to node ip-10-4-3-12 whose three psp-api client pods glow. Dimmer threads drop from payments and checkout to the nodes running them; no other threads are drawn. Floor labels read Application floor and Infrastructure floor; the HUD ladder shows both the A-ladder (A1 Territory lit) and the L-ladder (L2 Cluster lit), with a Floors chip, a causal-path panel with crossing chips, a minimap, an orbit compass and the Time Ribbon.
